note: Snapshot composition config — structural only. Screen order, titles, and which config keys feed each screen. Contains NO narrative copy: all participant-facing language resolves by key from the approved libraries (narratives-v1.0.json, connection-statements-v1.0.json, signal-state-vocabulary-v1.0.json). Titles marked title_source 'uiux' or 'prd' are exact approved participant-facing strings; titles marked 'structural' are working labels for screens the PRD/UIUX do not name. References to assessment-v1.0.json / scoring-v1.0.json are owned by other agents — listed here as feed pointers only.

screens.title: YOUR SET FOR LIFE FINANCIAL SNAPSHOT
screens.subtitle: A personalized look at how you currently see, direct, prepare, and make decisions with your money.

screens.title: Big Picture
screens.notes: Assembled per approved assembly templates only (STRENGTH + FRICTION + CONTEXT + CONNECTION + ACTIVATION order). Connection Statement rendered prominently.

screens.title: Financial Operating Profile
screens.notes: Participant-friendly operating labels SEE / ROOM / DIRECT / PREPARE / AIM / MOVE (PRD §20.1). Descriptive state labels only — no raw 1–5 values, no scores, no gauges.

screens.title: What’s Already Working for You
screens.notes: 1–3 evidence-supported strengths only. No invented strengths.

screens.title: Where There’s Friction
screens.notes: 1–3 meaningful findings. Null-finding rule applies: if NO_MEANINGFUL_FRICTION_IDENTIFIED, do not populate from low signals.

screens.title: The Connection / Here’s the Part Worth Noticing
screens.notes: Only a triggered tension/override key may render its statement. Editorial pull-quote treatment.

screens.title: What “Set for Life” Means to You
screens.notes: Participant Q16 selections displayed unranked. 'Destination Still Forming' presented neutrally. Question bank owned by another agent.

screens.title: Perception Gap
screens.conditional: only when the interpretation engine marks it meaningful
screens.notes: Never use 'wrong', 'misperception', 'reality check', or corrective arrows.

screens.title: Your Readiness Right Now
screens.notes: A1–A4 remain four separate statements. No combined index, no readiness score, no funnel label.

screens.title: ONE AREA WORTH EXAMINING NEXT
screens.notes: One primary area with visual priority; optional secondary is subordinate. Educational direction, not a financial recommendation.

screens.title: STAY CONNECTED — ON YOUR TERMS
screens.conditional: after substantive Snapshot value has been delivered; mobile optional and consent-specific
screens.notes: Phone entry and consent are separate controls. No pre-checked consent. Not required to unlock results.

screens.title: YOU DECIDE WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

continuation_options.label: Look Closer at My Financial Picture
Explore Ways to Create More Income

screens.notes: Full results delivered before continuation choices. All choices comparable visual dignity; NOT_RIGHT_NOW never punished or hidden. Never preselect from A4.

screens.title: Pilot Feedback
screens.conditional: only when pilot mode is enabled
screens.notes: Post-Snapshot validation survey. Rendered only under the pilot feature flag.
